SELECT 
    "target" AS "ip",
    COUNT(*) AS "openPortsCount"
FROM 
    `networkScanResult`
WHERE 
    ("target" = 127.0.0.1) AND 
    (EXTRACT(DAY FROM scanTime) = '2026-05-10') AND 
    (scanMethod IN ['native-net', 'tcp-udp'])
